title: Seating capacity of the premises
summary: How many customers you can seat in a space based on its total area.

dining-share-percentage.label: Share for the dining room
dining-share-percentage.placeholder: Percentage of the premises for dining, between 45 and 65 (e.g. 55)
dining-share-percentage.hint: The rest is kitchen (15–25%) and storage and services (20–35%).

area-per-customer-with-circulation.label: Area per customer with circulation
area-per-customer-with-circulation.placeholder: Square meters per person including walkways (e.g. 1.30)

steps.dining-area: Dining room = premises area × {diningSharePercentage} = {premisesArea} m² × {diningSharePercentage} = {diningArea} m²
steps.capacity: Covers = dining room ÷ area per customer = {diningArea} m² ÷ {areaPerCustomerWithCirculation} m² = {capacity} (rounded down)

manual-80-m2.title: 80 m² premises with 55% dining room and 1.30 m² per customer
